nom: Rael Vitamin C Dark Spot Corrector

segments.sensitive: Two reviewers specifically describe sensitive skin and report no irritation from the patches, while a separate reviewer with unspecified skin type describes a chemical-burn-like reaction and red blotches after use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with rosacea-related post-acne marks reports no noticeable improvement after two weeks of consistent use.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers describe dark spots from acne, bug bites, or old scars fading partially or fully with repeated use over one to three applications or about two weeks; a minority (several 1-3 star reviews) report little to no lightening even after following instructions.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers used the patches directly on active pimples or fresh scars and describe reduced redness, shrinkage, or faster healing overnight; one reviewer says the pimple blemish was still present after repeated tries.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers note the patch reduced redness and irritation around a spot overnight or within days; one long-time rosacea sufferer saw no improvement on marks over two years old.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports a chemical-burn-like reaction and a red blotch shaped like the patch after use, warning against combining with retinol or acids even if not used the same day.
concerns.dehydration: Two reviewers note the skin under the patch feels void of moisture or the area sheds a layer of skin afterward, prompting them to keep it moisturized.

aspects.libelle: Patch size too small for larger areas
Sticky residue or crust left after removal
Value for number of patches per pack

extraits.titre: Didn't work for marks over 2 years old
extraits.texte: I've been trying to get rid of the same post-acne marks from my rosacea for over 2 years now. I've had laser treatments done which never fully removed the spots. I followed all the instructions for this product (used every 2-3 days overnight for 6+ hours at a time for 2 weeks) and didn't see noticeable improvements on the one spot I tried the patches on. I might try other spots.

extraits.titre: Burns my skin. Leaves awful red blotch
extraits.texte: I tried using this a twice now and both time it chemically burned my skin. Once I thought maybe I made a mistake and mixed it with other product (retinol, etc) even though I was sure I didn't. I've taken a break for days from all harsher products and I still woke up with a red blotch and the exact shape of patch. It looks like a chemical burn and unfortunately will be on my face all day and even tomorrow. If you use any other acids or retinols do not use this product. Even if you're not currently on them, your skin could still have a bad reaction.

I have severe hormonal acne and I break out at the same time every month; it's really hard for me to have clear skin with that rigorous schedule, it feels like I constantly have dark spots on my face where the spots were. Combining these patches with a vitamin c serum in the morning has worked miracles for my skin this month. The patches are VERY sticky, and even if you move around a lot at night, they will not budge. They also don't hurt when being removed, and didn't tug my peach fuzz, which was a nice surprise! They peel off effortlessly, and my skin underneath is bouncy and refreshed, and significantly lighter than the night before. I'm really happy to have found something that actually works, and I'm really loving how clear my skin looks now, and rocking no makeup in public!

extraits.titre: Little patch with a mighty outcome!
extraits.texte: I struggle with dark spots on my face and was very happy to try Microcrystal Dark Spot Cover! After the first use I noticed a difference! I have sensitive skin and it didn't irritate it which is a big plus. I highly recommend using these patches if you have uneven skin!

extraits.titre: Seems to do tbe job if you have patience
extraits.texte: Easy application. No burning or red spots left over after the 6+ hours left on. After one application, it seemed to remove some of the lighter dark spot areas. Obviously I would need to do this longer to see a more drastic difference. However; my skin feels void of moisture in the areas that the patch was applied, so that concerned me for frequent use.

extraits.titre: I was skeptical but they really work!
extraits.texte: I had pretty bad acne as a teen and the scars have stuck around. Even as an adult, my acne tends to leave red marks long after it is gone. I figured I'd give this a try on some of the more noticeable spots. I didn't really have high hopes but was so surprised when I took the patch off the next morning! They visibly lessened my red spots. The patch is easy to apply and remove. The solution does crust a bit under the patch but when you wash your face it comes right off. These are completely worth it!!
I tried this product and it barely minimized my hyperpigmentation. It lightened up the dark spots by a bit but not a super noticeable difference.
